## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checks

- [ ] I ran `npm test` or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I did not include tokens, private telemetry, customer data, local config, or private endpoints.
- [ ] I updated README/docs when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated tests when behavior changed.

## Notes For Maintainer

Only the repository owner may approve, merge, tag releases, or publish packages.
